text:
Carmen Li: heads-up - SIN->FRA shipment on PO 2522 flagged by customs for "possible thermal variance". 6x H100 units stuck at FRA inbound.
Omega Logistics Rep: confirmed, carrier flagged different temp profiles across the pallet. we're requesting depot inspection photos & sensor logs now.
Diego Ramos: any quick mitigation? customer SLAs for dedicated pool start Mon.
Omega Logistics Rep: two short options: 1) split-ship 3x matched units from DE buffer tomorrow air (expedite fee EUR 2k/unit) to meet SLAs; 2) depot audit + conditional release (48-72h) if logs pass.
Mika - Procurement: vendor contract clause on customs incidents says vendor covers expedited freight if misclassification at their manifest. can you confirm who triggered reclass?
Omega Logistics Rep: manifests show AMS origin code mismatch due to batch re-labeling at factory; we will accept freight credit if you authorize split. customs broker fees still on receiver per contract.
ops-bot: Event: AWB FRA-321-000 - HOLD.
Carmen Li: we need serial continuity for billing. if split-shipping, vendor must provide temp serial mapping + ledger update immediately.
Diego Ramos: also want guarantee on replacements: vendor must supply thermal logs and depot photos within 12h of arrival or we reserve right to refuse acceptance.
Omega Logistics Rep: agreed. will issue AWB 654-321987 for 3x replacements ETA 05:00 UTC tomorrow, upload logs & photos within 12h, and issue a credit memo for expedited freight.
Mika - Procurement: approve split-ship to avoid SLA breach. I'll raise PO amendment and request finance hold customs broker dispute pending credit.
Carmen Li: Jordan, tag runbooks: eu-failover + rma-split. monitor storage charges - FRA quoted EUR 200/day after 48h.
Diego Ramos: ok, reassigning two canary nodes to US for now. note for PM: latency delta ~25ms p95.
Carmen Li: closing decision: split-ship 3 replacements, vendor covers expedited freight, must provide logs/photos and temp-serial ledger. customs broker fee escalated to procurement for credit. :thumbsup:
